_comment: Reference hook block for ~/.claude/settings.json (USER scope, Mike's decision 2026-08-25). CAVEAT (verified 2026-08-25 on 2.1.245): a project-local settings.json/settings.local.json with disableAllHooks:true DOES override user-scope hooks; only the managed policy tier cannot be overridden. Compensations: guard_bash denies shell writes to every governance path, session_context/stop_gate/make hooks-installed check every scope for disableAllHooks. Because user-scope hooks run in EVERY session on the machine, each hook exits 0 immediately unless the session cwd is inside McHomeLab or the inventory. Paste the `hooks` object into ~/.claude/settings.json (merge with existing keys). Commands point at the INSTALLED copies (~/.mhl/hooks), populated from main by scripts/mhl-install-hooks.
